none: PAS WAW-013D55: Roman coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Rally ID: 40. Roman coin: A struck / hammered copper alloy nummus, probably of Constantius II (323 - 361 AD), of reverse type GLORIA EXERCITVS (two soldiers, one standard), probably minted between 335 and 341 AD. Obverse: Bare head, laurel wreath facing right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN [ ]. Reverse: Two soldiers, one standard. Reverse inscription: [ ] TVS. Diameter: 14.88mm. Thickness: 1.39mm. Weight: 1.2 grams. Coin was photographed
